items.mainDefect: Moving device tagging into the synchronous authentication path makes anonymous authorization depend on database count and write latency.

secondary.defect: Removing the previous two-minute timeout leaves device tagging without an explicit bound when the database is slow or unresponsive.

items.mainDefect: The update timestamp window can exclude an existing device, causing a false ErrDeviceLimitReached rejection, including under clock skew between instances.

secondary.defect: MySQL can report zero affected rows for an unchanged update to an existing device, causing a false ErrDeviceLimitReached rejection.

items.mainDefect: The updateDevice comment incorrectly describes its internally computed timestamp window as times supplied to the function.

secondary.defect: The updateDevice comment omits that zero affected rows causes the function to return ErrDeviceLimitReached.
